facts.text: Container payment-gateway in pod payment-gateway-7f89d terminated with OOMKilled

citation.excerpt: Container terminated with exit code 137 OOMKilled

facts.text: Memory limit was set to 256Mi which was exceeded during traffic peak

hypotheses.title: Container terminated due to memory limit exhaustion (OOMKilled)
hypotheses.rationale: Exit code 137 combined with memory limit of 256Mi in describe output proves memory starvation.

recommendedNextSteps: Increase memory limit in deployment manifest from 256Mi to 512Mi
Profile application heap to verify baseline memory footprint

remediationProposal.title: Increase deployment memory limit to 512Mi
remediationProposal.problemSummary: The payment-gateway container exceeded its 256Mi memory limit and was killed by Linux OOM killer.
remediationProposal.suggestedConfigDescription: Update resource limits to prevent OOM termination during normal operation.
preconditions: Verify node allocatable memory capacity in cluster
remediationProposal.risksAndImpact: Rolling update of pods; zero downtime if replicas >= 2.
validationSteps: Check pod status after rollout: kubectl get pods -l app=payment-gateway
Verify no restarts after 15 minutes of synthetic load
remediationProposal.rollbackProcedure: Revert deployment limit back to previous revision using kubectl rollout undo.
